subtitle: A Mumbai weekend beach where a government seawall began caving into the sea within two years of construction starting.
spike_statement: A Maharashtra Maritime Board seawall built at Aksa Beach in 2022 and 2023 began caving in within two years; in 2025 a tribunal ruled it illegal.

levers.photo_tone: Grey monsoon light over cracked concrete seawall and dark Arabian Sea sand, Mumbai's skyline absent from the frame.
